title: Butterflies and Eyeball Field
description: A surreal landscape depicts a vibrant green grassy field dotted with numerous white spherical eyeballs featuring orange and blue irises. A flock of detailed butterflies with brown, black, and orange patterned wings flies across a pale sky filled with large white clouds above rolling green hills.
